Keep the composition centered with the three figures occupying the lower half of a vertical 2:3 canvas, leaving generous empty lavender space above. Show a half-body portrait of Paulo Dybala wearing the modern Boca Juniors home jersey, dark royal blue with a wide gold chest band, gold shoulder stripes, Adidas logo on the right chest, CABJ crest on the left chest, and “betsson” sponsor across the yellow band. The player is centered slightly to the right, cropped from upper torso to top of head, with short dark hair and athletic build, turning his head slightly to his left while pointing with his right index finger directly at the club crest on his chest. Do not show facial details clearly; keep the face obscured or out of focus. Use a deep blue textured stadium-themed background with glowing highlights and subtle grunge overlays. In the lower left background, include La Bombonera stadium facade with visible signage reading “LA BOMBONERA” and “CLUB ATLÉTICO BOCA JUNIORS.” Add small floating gold confetti particles throughout the scene for celebratory energy. Typography must be bold and poster-like: at the top left in small gold uppercase text, “BIENVENIDO A LA BOMBONERA”; below it a small gold star; then a huge stacked headline on the left with “BIENVENIDO” in tall white condensed uppercase and “DYBALA” in oversized gold condensed uppercase. Below the name, add smaller white uppercase text reading “PAULO DYBALA,” flanked by thin gold lines and a small gold star. At the bottom, place a thin gold horizontal line across the width and centered gold uppercase text reading “| JUGADOR DE BOCA |” with a gold star beneath it. Use high contrast, glossy sports-poster lighting, rich navy and gold color grading, sharp fabric detail, and an elite club announcement aesthetic.\

prompt_en: Create an epic dark-fantasy cinematic key art scene in a wide 16:9 format. A lone armored spellblade, Hermes, stands full-body in the foreground on wet ruined stone, facing the viewer in a heroic stance. The character wears ornate blackened steel and bronze plate armor with layered leather belts, pouches, engraved pauldrons, tall boots, and a tattered windblown dark navy cloak and scarf. Their face is deliberately obscured by a soft rectangular blur, while dark hair is visible above it. In the left hand they hold a long silver sword angled downward; in the right hand they raise a twisted black mage staff topped with a bright circular blue magical sigil, glowing runes, sparks, and swirling energy. The background is a vast gothic fantasy landscape at sunset: misty valleys, jagged snowy mountains, a distant cathedral-like castle with spires, ancient ruined arches and towers on the left, broken statues and rocks on the right, and low fog drifting across the ground. Lighting is dramatic, with orange-pink sunset clouds behind the mountains contrasted against cool blue magical light from the staff reflecting on armor and puddles. Use ultra-detailed realistic digital painting, high contrast, volumetric fog, cinematic composition, sharp armor details, moody atmosphere, no text, no watermark. Customize the sky mood as stormy orange and violet sunset, the magic color as electric blue, the armor style as ornate dark medieval plate armor, and the background landmark as distant gothic castle in the mountains.\

prompt_en: A wide cinematic anime key visual of a bustling modern Tokyo-like district transformed into a multicultural fantasy metropolis under a bright blue midday sky with fluffy clouds. The scene is viewed from street level along a broad pedestrian avenue leading toward a large red torii gate at the center distance, with stone steps, crowds of people, dense commercial buildings, and a Japanese castle rising on a green hill behind the city blocks. A very tall broadcasting tower resembling Tokyo Skytree stands slightly right of center in the background. Fill the sky with exactly 8 airborne fantasy and sci-fi elements: 2 large dragons in flight, 2 winged humanoid angels, 1 huge flying saucer, and 3 smaller UFOs scattered farther away. The city should feel like a coexistence society where humans and fantasy races live together naturally. Add many colorful digital billboards and vertical signs on buildings, including Japanese text and fantasy character advertisements; the largest curved screen on the left should display the text “Shinpi Sekai 神秘世界 ようこそ,” and a lower billboard should reference a multicultural society of different races. In the foreground, place exactly 6 prominent characters across the street scene: on the far left, a tall elf schoolgirl with long brown hair, pointed ears, a white blouse, ribbon tie, and plaid skirt; left-center, a humanoid crocodile or lizard man in casual urban clothes with a jacket and pendant; near him, a small child with animal-like ears wearing a red backpack and scarf; center-left, a white-haired young man with white feathered wings in a light jacket; center-right, a silver-haired cat-eared schoolgirl in a light jacket and dark pleated skirt; right-center, a black-haired teenage boy in a black hoodie with a backpack; and on the far right, a blonde elf schoolgirl with pointed ears, white short-sleeve shirt, tie, and brown plaid skirt. In the midground and background, add a crowd of pedestrians including a few more fantasy species. Also include exactly 3 additional perched or elevated fantasy figures on the right side architecture: 1 dark-clad black-winged girl standing on a ledge, 1 small blonde fairy-like winged girl floating near a rooftop, and 1 tiny golden winged creature near the street. Style: polished high-detail anime illustration, light novel promotional art, sharp linework, vibrant colors, clean atmospheric perspective, crisp sunlight, soft shadows, highly detailed urban signage, a sense of wonder, coexistence, and worldbuilding.\

Use an elegant, symmetrical poster layout with thin gold decorative border lines and small ornamental corner details. At the top center, place a minimalist gold mountain emblem above the word “DISCOVER”, then a very large refined serif title reading AUSTRIA in deep burgundy red. Beneath it, add a small uppercase tagline in gold: “TIMELESS BEAUTY. RICH HERITAGE. UNFORGETTABLE EXPERIENCES.” and below that an italic script line: “Where Tradition Meets Breathtaking Nature.” Place a small horizontal Austrian flag motif between the lines. The main image should be a breathtaking composite alpine lake scene at golden hour: on the left, a dramatic hilltop fortress resembling Salzburg Castle perched on a rocky cliff above the water; in the center distance, a calm reflective lake leading into a valley of towering snow-capped Alps; on the right, a picturesque Austrian lakeside village resembling Hallstatt with steep-roofed houses, a tall church spire, a hillside church, and clustered wooden buildings descending to the water. Warm sunlight from the left, crisp blue sky, glowing highlights on the mountains, rich reflections in the lake, romantic cinematic atmosphere, ultra-detailed, majestic and inviting. Her pose is aggressive and airborne: one leg thrust forward toward the camera, the other bent high, one arm extended back for balance, and the other holding a short electrified baton or compact blade with a glowing cyan tip.

2. Photo set panel, lower center: label “フォトセット”, show exactly 6 sample photo thumbnails arranged in a 2-row collage, divided into vertical set and horizontal set labels, with large translucent “SAMPLE” text stamped over several thumbnails, a speech bubble saying 3 random photos out of 6 total are included, and a gold price badge “¥1,100”.
3. Tapestry panel, upper-right: label “タペストリー”, sublabel “A2サイズ”, show one A2 wall-hanging tapestry mockup with the same woman’s portrait, hanging from a black rod and string, a circular note saying it is a large A2 tapestry to decorate a room, and a gold price badge “¥4,400”.
